technology_name: AN EFFECTIVE METHOD FOR DESIGN OPTIMIZATION AND FABRICATION OF CUTTING TOOLS USING ADDITIVE MANUFACTURING
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Traditional subtractive machining architectures cannot drill complex internal conformal cooling fluid loops into high-performance industrial cutting tools, resulting in severe heat accumulation and tool fracture.
description: An optimized additive manufacturing strategy utilizing layer-by-layer metal powder deposition to forge high-strength multipoint cutting inserts embedded with advanced internal lattice channels and tailored internal coolant outlets.
applications: CNC precision industrial milling setups, extreme-duty automotive tool production lines, high-speed aerospace component metal cutting, and specialized metallurgy manufacturing.
